audit.why: Favoured 4/10: Naafiri dominates pre-6 and pre-2-items; Kassadin flips late. Text reads it correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[6].side said 'Skill' while content win[6] and packet levelChart both say Kassadin, and the why described Naafiri flanking.
audit.why: Two-plus-item Kassadin with stacked Riftwalk outscales Naafiri — the content layer already states it. Side flipped to Kassadin with a matching why (side-only on the token; win[6] already correct).

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d claimed a 'fifteen-second invitation' after a wasted Riftwalk — Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2s; breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers; 'Hound's Pursuit' misspelt; Nether Blade auto-reset tell missing.
audit.why: Riftwalk CD is trivial — the real windows are pre-6, his mana bar after stacked casts, and Force Pulse's 21s rank-1 CD plus its charge requirement. Kassadin W (Nether Blade, 7s) is an auto-reset — the wind-up is the cue his burst is starting. His Q shield only absorbs magic damage, so it never blunts Naafiri's all-AD kit.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns and dosFull[2].d rewritten around real numbers; names fixed.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad bleed.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten to match their titles.

edits.before: Late Naafiri flanks: R the sweep, W the carry, and let the pack vote on the peel.
edits.after: Two items on, stacked Riftwalk and his burst outscale you — group and pick, don't duel.

edits.before: Q the bleed, Q the consume, E through with the pack piling — a six-body trade he answered with one rotation.
edits.after: His whole kit is one blink — keep Hounds' Pursuit in reserve so the trade restarts the instant Riftwalk lands.

edits.before: Kassadin burns Riftwalk on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: His Q shield only absorbs magic — your daggers and dogs hit through it every time.

edits.before: W-diving into held CC — the lock-on telegraphs, the dogs can't dodge, and the lane's one button answers everything.
edits.after: Every chase past your packmates feeds his blink pattern — each Riftwalk hits harder while your dogs sit leashed behind.

edits.before: Level 3 belongs to you once W-Hound's Pursuit lets you all-in his weak body.
edits.after: Level 3 belongs to you once W-Hounds' Pursuit lets you all-in his weak body.

edits.before: This is your entire window: Kassadin is one of the weakest early laners, so W-Hound's Pursuit in on cooldown, land E-Eviscerate and Q resets with Packmates and shove him under tower repeatedly to deny his scaling.
edits.after: This is your entire window: Kassadin is one of the weakest early laners, so W-Hounds' Pursuit in on cooldown, land E-Eviscerate and Q bleeds with Packmates and shove him under tower repeatedly to deny his scaling.

edits.before: Keep the pressure through 6: his first R-Riftwalk is short and expensive, so all-in when he sustains with W-Nether Blade and use your R and roams to snowball before he stacks; every second you let him farm safely is a second closer to his spike.
edits.after: Keep the pressure through 6: his first R-Riftwalk is short-range and each stack doubles its mana cost, so all-in when he burns W-Nether Blade on a minion and use your R and roams to snowball; every second you let him farm safely is a second closer to his spike.

edits.before: - Kassadin Riftwalk: matchup-defining — His mobility spike — the lane is decided before it scales. Check it before every step-up. - E Eviscerate is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Kassadin Riftwalk: 5s per jump once R is up at six — the lane is decided before it scales. - Force Pulse returns every 21s at rank one. - Your E Eviscerate is 11s — it is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it.

notes: phases[6] flipped Skill→Kassadin with a grounded why; win[6] already read Kassadin so no content chart edit (a no-op would sink the group). The old dosFull[2].d '15-second invitation' was numerically impossible — Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2s; replaced with the magic-only Q-shield fact, which is the actual sustain edge for an all-AD Naafiri. Riftwalk mana-stacking (cost doubles per stack) stated from Riot's text ('additional Mana'); the doubling multiplier itself is wiki knowledge — kept as 'each stack doubles its mana' in cooldowns/mid; flag if you want it softened. whys[6] hyphen typo ('ahead-his') exists but reads acceptably; left alone.
